posts.title: Automating Obsidian With Python Organize Tool
posts.description: When self-hosting it's easy to accumulate self-hosted apps that look pretty but you don't use much. These often store data that could've been a text file. A few years ago I started using Obsidian to store Markdown notes. Obsidian's value comes from plugins rather than the core app itself.
